courses.title: React Fundamentals
courses.description: Learning React.js is the process of mastering Meta’s popular JavaScript library to build fast, interactive, and component-based user interfaces for web applications. It bridges the gap between basic web design and modern, scalable frontend software development.

courses.title: JavaScript Advanced
courses.description: Learning JavaScript (JS) is the journey of mastering the core programming language that powers interactive web pages, dynamic user actions, and full-stack applications. It involves moving from basic syntax like variables and loops to advanced concepts like object manipulation and server-side logic.

courses.title: Node.js Basics
courses.description: Learning Node.js transitions you from a client-side frontend developer to a full-stack engineer by enabling you to run JavaScript on the server. Instead of manipulating what a user sees in the browser, learning Node.js teaches you how to manage data, handle network requests, and interact directly with computer operating systems.

courses.title: User interface Basics
courses.description: A learning user interface (UI) is the visual and interactive space within an educational platform.
